name: us021-state-unchanged
description: T020 [US2]: reconcile a three-story specification to completion, then reconcile it again with nothing changed. The second run's calls.log must be empty (not merely free of writes, as us2-zero-churn-unchanged.json already proves — no recognition read either), its exit 0, and its stdout must name the short-circuit. With SPEC_KIT_JIRA_TIMING on, the second run's stderr must carry only the prereq, state, and total phases (invariant T8, contracts/timing-report.md §3).
